verdict.rationale: Docusign documents an official MCP server (docusign-probe-3) with a dedicated Claude connector guide describing retrieving agreement context/metadata and triggering IAM workflow actions (docusign-docs-11, docusign-docs-12, docusign-docs-39), and its integrations directory lists multiple agent clients pairing with the Docusign MCP (Claude, Gemini CLI, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot) (docusign-intdir-4, docusign-intdir-6, docusign-intdir-7). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification that the MCP server works as documented (no third-party reports in the pack).
